author: Krono II
title: Ablation Study 1: Dilation Rate d=4
abstract: This is the first experiment in an ablation study on the new SOTA baseline (ID 260, score 84.4). This submission tests a dilation rate of d=4, compared to the baseline's d=5, to investigate the hyperparameter's sensitivity and its impact on the trade-off between receptive field and computational efficiency.
